title: cuJSON: A Highly Parallel JSON Parser for GPUs
relevance: Designed minimal-branching JSON parsing for GPUs where branching causes warp divergence. Demonstrates that branch-free parsing yields significant speedups on parallel architectures.

title: Control Flow Merging: A Compiler Transformation to Mitigate Branch Misprediction by Branch Elimination
relevance: Compiler-level approach to eliminating branches by merging control flow paths. Provides theoretical backing for converting branching parsers to branchless table-driven implementations.

title: Branch Prediction: The Definitive Guide for High-Performance C++
relevance: Comprehensive guide to branch prediction optimization in C++. Provides practical techniques for converting branching code to branchless alternatives.

title: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
relevance: simdjson's Stage 1 already uses bit-parallel techniques to avoid branches in structural indexing. Stage 2 (value parsing) still has branches that this concept eliminates.
